claims: The Artemis II Orion capsule splashed down in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego, California.
The Artemis II Orion capsule splashed down at 8:07 p.m. EDT on April 10, 2026.
The Artemis II Orion capsule splashdown occurred at 5:07 p.m. PDT on April 10, 2026.
The Artemis II crew was recovered by the USS John P. Murtha.
The Artemis II mission departed on April 1, 2026.
The Artemis II mission returned on April 10, 2026.
The Artemis II mission lasted just under 10 days.
The Artemis II mission went around the Moon.
The Artemis II crew consisted of NASA astronauts Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Canadian Space Agency astronaut Jeremy Hansen.
Space.com reports that the Artemis II crew landed safely.
